ValidationRule.description: Block Assignment from and to BOT Users - ( https://app.asana.com/0/1203315724044772/1206026715095663/f https://app.asana.com/0/1204573690586060/1206569274136037/f )
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), RecordType.Name = "Customer Account", OR( ISPICKVAL(Owner.Business_Function__c , "BOTS"), ISPICKVAL(Last_Owner__r.Business_Function__c , "BOTS") ), NOT( OR( $Permission.Account_Reassign_to_Bots, $Permission.Admin_Automation_Exclusion ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to reassign Accounts from or to BOT users.
